banking.limit_formula: limit = min(LTV x collateral value, 3 x annual net income)
banking.rate_formula: rate = base 4 % + risk premium; premium = 2 % x (1 - income score) + 3 % x route risk + 2 % x legal risk + 4 % x prior defaults + 1 % x debt/income
